examples.text: „Wie sehr man sich doch täuschen konnte. Und das alles nur wegen einer jungen Frau mit blauen Augen, die die nerdigste Person war, der er jemals begegnet war.”

examples.text: That guy is nerdy and weird.

glosses: Of, pertaining to, in the style of, or appealing to nerds.

examples.text: I got a pair of nerdy glasses and clothes for Halloween.

The cleverest and most prolific inventors, such as Reiner Knizia (who lives in England) are nerdy superstars. Euro (also “German-style”) games must not be confused with “Ameritrash” games, which generally involve high drama and employ plastic pieces, though arguing over what the difference is seems to be gamers' second-favourite pastime.
